entities.name: Bo
entities.description: Human, about twenty, protective older brother of Mira and caretaker after their parents' death.

entities.name: Mira
entities.description: Human girl of about nine, Bo's sister, bitten by a rattlewurm.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: Person Bo and Mira met who deals with the rattlewurm threat.

entities.name: Saddlebrush
entities.description: Town on Thunder Junction where Bo and Mira live.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane where Bo and Mira ended up.

entities.name: Rattlewurm
entities.description: Dangerous creature that threatened Saddlebrush and bit Mira.

events.summary: Bo and Mira travel to Thunder Junction with their mother, who dies there leaving them orphans in Saddlebrush.
events.quote: She died on that plane, leaving them orphans in the town of Saddlebrush .

events.summary: Bo and Mira meet Annie Flash a few months later.
events.quote: They met Annie Flash a few months later.

events.summary: A rattlewurm threatens Saddlebrush and bites Mira.
events.quote: Mira was bitten, which deeply distressed Bo.

events.summary: Bo volunteers to join Annie Flash on the mission against the rattlewurm.
events.quote: He volunteered to join Annie Flash on a mission to deal with the rattlewurm

relations.quote: Bo and Mira are human siblings from an unknown plane
Bo and Mira are siblings living in the town of Saddlebrush .
